spoken_text: Welcome back. Your usual route and cabin preferences are ready.
Temperature, lighting, and audio settle into your preferred settings.
On the highway, Eva combines local D M S evidence with driving workload.
Early fatigue signs bring cooler air and a calm suggestion to rest.
Fatigue is now severe. Reaching a safe rest point becomes the priority.
Rest mode is active. The cabin quiets down to support recovery.
Rain, darkness, and congestion now raise the driving workload together.
A vehicle brakes ahead. Level two assistance responds cautiously under driver supervision.
The road clears, and regular cabin services return without a sudden transition.
Eva remembers a parking card in the driver-side door pocket.
A down-left glance matches the search, so Eva explains where the card was last seen.
Your eyes return forward. The reading light turns off, and the loop closes.
The final scene links local D M S evidence with a clearly simulated O M S event.
O M S detects movement at the rear-right window and starts timing it.
The driver glance aligns with that passenger event, while fatigue evidence remains normal.
Rear-right passenger, move fully inside. Eva is reducing speed and extending distance.
The passenger is back inside. Eva now checks that driver attention has recovered.
Both signals show recovery. The temporary protection can now be released.
Moment Trace preserves the input, decision, action, verification, and source boundaries.
Five Eva experiences complete.
